title: Reconcile and prepare exact admission-family performance measurement
summary: Rebind the admission cell space to the reviewed family catalog, add exact performance-only A0-A7 runtime authorization, preserve the deterministic dry-run campaign, and execute the selected A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot through the ProtocolLab rack package boundary.
planned_changes: Keep factor-cell-space v3 and the retained timing-disabled campaign immutable; add an exact manifest-bound performance-only admission token, option propagation, runtime gate, and focused negative tests; add an additive selected-pilot control and deterministic compiler for ProtocolLab rack execution of A0, A3, A4, and A7; extend the raw QUIC package, adapter, and server boundary with exact three-axis and authorization identity; submit isolated-pair package-backed jobs for the existing multiplex.100x64kb workload; retain controller artifacts; and classify pilot effects without accepting or activating a policy.
verification_plan: Validate all new canonical JSON against its schema and recompute hashes; prove exactly A0, A3, A4, and A7 compile into the selected pilot while bounded cells, covering-array intent, outside axes, stale hashes, wrong host or workload, correctness intent, active intent, and performance-acceptance intent fail closed; run focused runtime and package authorization tests; build source, raw server, adapter, and tests in Release; verify controller package identity, isolated topology, job outcomes, artifact readability, runtime cell identity, activation accounting, release accounting, failed and timeout request counts, and checksums; validate the four touched SpecTrace artifacts directly; and run git diff --check.
completion_notes: Readiness, exact package-path runtime authorization, deterministic A0/A3/A4/A7 compilation, pinned component packages, failure-state retention, and topology classification are complete. Commits 808c4725, be388845, and f95486db repaired the reviewed multi-axis Stage 1 authorization path and hardened rack evidence retention. The repaired A0 reached ProtocolLab twice but failed payload validation because the adaptive evidence path emitted 645 MB to 1.73 GB of stdout per short job and dropped release records; the same pinned workload without adaptive evidence completed both repetitions with only 571 stdout bytes. All attempts selected plab-worker-sut-01 and plab-worker-load-01 on shared physicalHostId lenovo-p620, so no result is credible performance evidence. A4, A3, and A7 remain planned. The next implementation slice is bounded compact aggregate evidence, followed by an independently hosted SUT/load pair. Actual credible measurements remain zero.
out_of_scope: Accepting a performance policy or activating an adaptive rule
CI modification, push, or deletion of retained evidence
Presenting a local dry run or topology-incomplete rack run as credible performance evidence
